verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs say users can pick among models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor. Model selection is exposed per session in the CLI (`--model gpt-5`), in the Cloud Agents API (`model.id` from GET /v1/models) and for custom subagents, and bring-your-own keys extend this to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI and Bedrock. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-editor model picker, and model choice for Tab completion (which stays on Cursor's built-in models).
